**3B.6 Research Note: Olaf Scholz in 2024**

**Assessment:** The record is **mostly positive** on reducing domestic fear and insecurity through calm, institutional, law-based responses. I did **not** find evidence that Scholz replaced ordinary insecurity with state terror or a broader fear climate. The main counterweights are the year-end coalition collapse and the Taurus leak, which increased instability and misperception risk, plus the surveillance-oversight defect found by the Constitutional Court.

| Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| **Scholz: Germany’s security authorities had prepared for a high-risk summer** | Bundesregierung | 6 Jun 2024 | https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/suche/scholz-sicherheitslage-2291096 | Scholz framed safety as a core state duty, backed police and prosecutors, and said the state would respond to killings and attacks with the full force of the law. This is direct evidence of a calm, rule-of-law response to insecurity. | **3B.6**, also **3B.2**, **3B.4** |
| **Germany’s first National Security Strategy** | Bundesregierung | 14 Jun 2023, operative in 2024 | https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/aktuelles/national-security-strategy-2196356 | The strategy is a prevention-oriented, whole-of-government approach including diplomacy, police, fire brigades, civil protection, cyber security, supply-chain resilience, and pandemic prevention. That is a structural answer to insecurity, not terror or intimidation. | **3B.6**, also **3B.4**, **3B.5** |
| **Scholz on the security situation / flood preparedness** | Bundesregierung | 6 Jun 2024 | https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/suche/scholz-sicherheitslage-2291096 | Scholz emphasized floods, warning systems, and coordinated disaster response that had already saved lives. This supports a fear-reduction posture grounded in preparedness and practical protection. | **3B.6** |
| **Scholz: IRIS-T air defense protects lives** | Bundesregierung | 5 Sep 2024 | https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/service/newsletter-und-abos/bulletin/rede-von-bundeskanzler-olaf-scholz-2307114 | Scholz described air defense as a life-protecting measure that intercepts rockets, drones, and cruise missiles. This is evidence of security policy aimed at reducing civilian fear, not amplifying it. | **3B.6**, also **3B.1** |
| **Terror attacks and political violence condemnations** | Deutscher Bundestag | 6 Jun 2024 | https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw23-de-regierungserklaerung-1006098 | In the aftermath of the Mannheim police killing, Scholz backed tougher punishment, said attackers would face the full force of the law, and stressed there is no rule of the fist. This is a stabilizing response, not a fear campaign. | **3B.6**, also **3B.2**, **3B.4** |
| **Germany cannot accept spying, says Scholz after suspected China spy arrested** | Reuters / Investing.com | 24 Apr 2024 | https://uk.investing.com/news/world-news/germany-cannot-accept-spying-says-scholz-after-suspected-china-spy-arrested-3451540 | Scholz said Germany would not accept foreign spying and wanted those responsible prosecuted, while avoiding prejudgment. That is due-process framing rather than broad security panic. | **3B.6**, also **3B.4** |
| **Against hatred - For humanity and order** | Bundesregierung | 20 Jan 2024 | https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-en/kanzler-kompakt-against-hatred-for-humanity-and-order-2254034 | Scholz urged unity, tolerance, and opposition to right-wing extremism, and defended Germany’s migrant-background population as part of the country. This is an anti-fear, anti-scapegoating message. | **3B.6**, also **3B.3** |
| **Germany’s coalition collapse and political chaos** | Reuters / Investing.com | 6 Nov 2024 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/explainergerman-coalition-collapses-what-comes-next-3706936 | Scholz fired Lindner, collapsing the coalition and triggering political chaos. This is counterevidence because it worsened domestic instability and likely increased public uncertainty late in 2024. | **3B.6**, also **3B.10** |
| **Scholz loses no-confidence vote** | Deutscher Bundestag | 16 Dec 2024 | https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw47-vertrauensfrage-1030198 | The Bundestag withdrew confidence by a large margin, opening the way for snap elections. This reinforces the year-end instability and weakened authority that undercut domestic reassurance. | **3B.6**, also **3B.10** |
| **Germany treated intercepted Taurus discussion as a security incident** | AP | 4 Mar 2024 | https://apnews.com/article/russia-germany-ukraine-taurus-missiles-recording-de408772f1edf3bd2f98fd5a3f64da3c | The leaked military call became a real security incident and prompted investigation. This is counterevidence because it increased tension and misperception risk, even though the government responded institutionally. | **3B.6**, also **3B.4**, **3B.5** |
| **BVerfG: BND surveillance powers partly unconstitutional** | Bundesverfassungsgericht | 8 Nov 2024 | https://www.bundesverfassungsgericht.de/SharedDocs/Pressemitteilungen/EN/2024/bvg24-093.html | The Court found parts of the BND surveillance framework unconstitutional and said oversight was inadequate. This is the main structural counterweight: it shows an overbroad security apparatus still existed, though not proof of Scholz personally creating a fear climate. | **3B.6**, also **3B.5**, **3B.4** |

**Bottom line**
- Scholz’s 2024 record is more consistent with **risk reduction through institutions, law enforcement, and preparedness** than with intimidation or state terror.
- The strongest negative evidence is **late-2024 political instability**, the **Taurus leak**, and the **surveillance-oversight defect**.
- I found **no reliable evidence** that he intentionally governed through terror or a broad political fear climate.
